text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having eaten and trained well, Tamamo 
Cross has built a body that meets the bare 
minimum requirements to compete as an 
athlete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, if her goal was the Classic 
Triple Crown, her body still lacked the 
necessary strength...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross broods over her frustration. 
However, she fires herself up, determined 
not to lose to a "certain local Umamusume" 
who is aiming high and working just as 
hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vowing to her family to do her best, she 
set a goal to place 3rd or higher in 4 
graded races by Senior Year, January.
